tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who missed a recent class. You want to ask your classmate, Jessica, for her notes and any important details from the class. Write an email to Jessica.
bullets: Explain why you missed the class.
Ask for her notes and explain why you need them.
Suggest what you could do for her in return.
tasks.subject: Request for class notes
